## 4.1.68 (HexGhoul): Ken's tower gone; Ken on Anteiku's roof

HexKagune 4.1.68 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (125).

Your words (quoted exactly): "Ken's cybertower is now fully removed, he is to spawn on top of Anteikou."

- **The cyber tower is gone:** its structure, its set, its pool and its template are deleted, and it's out of every list of places (the one
  of a kind places, `/kagune places`, the places laid out on dry land). New worlds never build it.
- **Ken is now made with Anteiku, on its roof:** Anteiku's template carries him on the café's flat roof (the spruce deck inside its
  parapet), at its south edge over the street, looking out the way the café faces, where he sits when he has nothing to do; Touka is still
  behind the counter below. His home reads "Anteiku's roof". The café itself is unchanged, block for block.
- **Worlds made before:** a tower already built stays standing (generated blocks can't be unmade), and a Ken already made keeps his old
  home. A world where Anteiku isn't built yet gets him on its roof.

### Other

- Render: `docs/handoff/ken-anteiku-roof-4.1.68.png` (Anteiku from two corners; a red and white stand-in where the template puts Ken, at
